note: GRATUS MODELS. Emojis kept together on the same day, three days over, become a model: a small, named pattern of how something grows, gets built, begins, pays, coordinates, or heals. The formula is the emojis; the result is the emoji the model gives you, planted in your field; the statement is the law; the loop is the mechanism in one line. Statements are plain and the owner may refine any of them.

models.name: Compound Morning
models.statement: Small daily input, kept, becomes a capacity.
models.loop: input every day → capacity → better input

models.name: Seed and Water
models.statement: Attention is the water. What you attend to grows.

models.name: Slow Sun
models.statement: Growth follows the light you give it, on its own schedule.

models.name: Walk It Off
models.statement: A walk turns weight into ground.

models.name: The Long Book
models.statement: Reading at night rewrites the morning.

models.name: Body First
models.statement: Fuel, then effort, then rest.

models.name: Practice Loop
models.statement: Repetition with attention is how skill grows.

models.name: Still Point
models.statement: Stillness widens the channel everything moves through.

models.name: Yearly Ring
models.statement: One ring a year. No shortcut, and no loss.

models.name: Rain to River
models.statement: Hard days gather into a current.

models.name: Brick a Day
models.statement: One brick, kept, is a wall by spring.

models.name: Sketch Then Build
models.statement: Draw it before you build it.

models.name: Keystone
models.statement: Find the piece the rest depend on. Place it first.

models.name: The Workshop
models.statement: A place for the work makes the work happen.

models.name: Blueprint
models.statement: Notes with an aim become a plan.

models.name: Thread and Needle
models.statement: Small joins make strong cloth.

models.name: Fix It
models.statement: A repair is an idea with its hands dirty.

models.name: Ship It
models.statement: Share it before it is perfect.

models.name: Foundation
models.statement: What you build on decides what you can build.

models.name: Sharp Tools
models.statement: Care for the tool and the tool cares for you.

models.name: First Light
models.statement: An idea is a morning. Get up.

models.name: Two Founders
models.statement: An idea with a hand in it can stand.

models.name: Ask Ten People
models.statement: Ask ten people before you plan.

models.name: Smallest Thing
models.statement: Build the smallest piece that proves the whole.

models.name: Runway
models.statement: Time is the runway. Money only buys time.

models.name: Pivot
models.statement: When the map is wrong, turn. Keep the compass.

models.name: Word of Mouth
models.statement: A gift told twice is a market.

models.name: Launch Day
models.statement: A launch is a beginning wearing a party hat.

models.name: Night Shift
models.statement: The quiet hours build what the loud hours sell.

models.name: Founder's Rest
models.statement: Rest is part of the sprint.

models.name: Value First
models.statement: Give value first. Money is the echo.

models.name: Counted
models.statement: What you count, you can keep.

models.name: Set Aside
models.statement: A tenth, set aside, becomes what you lean on.
models.loop: set aside → grow → lean → set aside

models.name: Fair Scale
models.statement: A fair deal is repeated. An unfair one is remembered.

models.name: Return Customer
models.statement: Loved once, returned twice. Profit is return.

models.name: Plain Price
models.statement: Price it plainly.

models.name: Slow Money
models.statement: Money that took time stays.

models.name: The Tab
models.statement: Bread today, bread tomorrow. That is the whole ledger.

models.name: Split
models.statement: Share the upside and the upside grows.

models.name: Enough
models.statement: Knowing enough is the largest profit.

models.name: Common Ground
models.statement: Keep the same thing, both accept it. That is a team.

models.name: Same Page
models.statement: Put the plan in one line everyone sees.

models.name: The Call
models.statement: A call closes distance faster than a plan.

models.name: Circle
models.statement: Return to the same people on purpose.

models.name: Handoff
models.statement: Pass it on cleanly and it keeps moving.

models.name: Bridge
models.statement: Two shores need one span. Be the span.

models.name: One Bell
models.statement: One signal everyone hears saves a hundred messages.

models.name: Shared Table
models.statement: Eat together. Decide after.

models.name: Open Door
models.statement: An open door is a rule that needs no meeting.

models.name: Two Yeses
models.statement: Nothing shared without two yeses.

models.name: Kept Light
models.statement: Thanks and a candle, kept, become morning.

models.name: Rest Is Growth
models.statement: Rest is also growth.

models.name: Held
models.statement: Fear, with a hand in it, loosens.

models.name: Named
models.statement: A feeling named is a feeling held.

models.name: The Walk Home
models.statement: The way home is part of the day.

models.name: Repair
models.statement: Hurt and thanks in the same day: that is repair.

models.name: Tend the Person
models.statement: Tend the person, not just the feeling.

models.name: Present
models.statement: The ground asks if you're here. You answer with a touch.

models.name: Given Hands
models.statement: Thanks, with hands, reaches the world.

models.name: Morning After
models.statement: Every hard night has a morning after it.
